title: Discovering Jimmy Blanton in St. Louis
summary: Greer hears Blanton at a Fate Marable jam session and gets Duke to hire him for the Case Hotel.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Now, we talked about a lot of the people in the bands, worked with the bands. We talked about traveling to different countries and you've done a lot of different kinds of things. I wanted to get some of your recollections about some of the individuals in the bands who haven't been really written and talked about that much. Like Jimmy Blanton, for instance. What do you recall about him when he joined the band?

Well, Jimmy Blanton, the first time I heard him was in St. Louis. We were in St. Louis to play the Case Hotel the first time they ever had a colored band. And so the night before -- we had two days off so the night before I went out on the town, and Fate Marable had a lot of very good musicians played on his boat, you know. So him and I were real tight.

So he say, "I want you to come up here. There's a jam session tomorrow and my boys, some of them are going to be there." So I went up, and him and I, we sat down, just relaxing a little taste. He say, I got a bass player I want you to hear. So all right, I see this guy, young kid, nice looking boy. And he played -- two or three more bass players played before him. He come up there and all my life I'd never heard nobody like this guy. Never heard nobody
play bass like him. There were some good bass players, but like him, never.

And the reason he was so different and fantastic, his first instrument was a violin. He could sit down in the concert, symphony orchestra and play the lead violin. That's how good he was. And on that bass, it's hard -- it's not difficult; he done so many things.

So I rushed back to the hotel and got Duke. I said, 'Man, come and hear this kid play.' So Duke went up and Duke was amazed like I was because Duke could see farther, what he could do. And Duke say, 'I'm going to get him.' So we had Billy Taylor was our bass player then. So Duke went up to Jimmy and say, 'How would you like to open at the hotel with us?' He said, 'All right.' And Fate (UNINTELLIGIBLE) told him, 'Man, that's a chance of a lifetime.'

And sure enough, he opened up at the Case Hotel with us. And it's too much. Too much, because he had a lot of his solos he gave to Duke, and we just turned him loose. And he fit the band like a glove. All the guys loved him, he was that type of guy, you know. So Duke say -- Duke gave him a featured spot all the way through the band, individual solos, because different guys doing an engagement, they'd get some solos. They turned him loose and the house caved in. He's something else.
